hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook that facilitates 1:1 swapping between ETH and phiEth (a 1:1 ETH wrapper). In beforeSwap, it takes the input token from the PoolManager, converts via phiEth.deposit()/phiEth.withdraw(), and settles the output — bypassing the AMM's concentrated liquidity entirely. Adding liquidity directly to the pool is blocked.
